messages.author: Ingrid Solberg
messages.text:
Re Tomasz's traffic-quality theory: Android D1 by channel, install cohorts before Jul 22 vs Jul 22-27 (D1-mature, excluding unity_video_retarget):
- Meta 36.2% -> 29.6%
- AppLovin 37.8% -> 31.4%
- Organic 41.5% -> 34.0%
- Google / TikTok / Unity playable: same ~6pt drop
iOS: 39.9% -> 40.1%, flat.
The step is on one day, on one platform, in every source including Organic. Ad networks don't touch Organic users, so this is the app, not the traffic.

replies.author: Felix Brandt
replies.text: Android 2.14.0 hit 100% rollout at ~19:00 UTC on Jul 21. That would make Jul 22 the first full cohort on the new build.

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: That matches exactly, the Jul 21 cohort itself still looks normal.

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: Not obviously yet, daily_kpis is game-wide and dominated by the existing user base. Should show up as Android DAU sliding faster than iOS over the next weeks.
